newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-Finnlines Jan-April profit to dip.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Finnlines Jan-April profit to dip.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 110 million markka median forecast for shipping company Finnlines Oy's January-April 1997 profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(EPS forecasts by six analysts, profit forecasts by 11.)
The results are due next Thursday, May 22.
In January-April 1996, Finnlines posted a 217 million profit before extraordinary items.
In February, Finnlines said it expected 1997 operating earnings to match the 1996 level. Finnlines' full-year 1996 pre-tax profit was 404 million markka.
The median of forecasts for Finnlines' full-year 1997 earnings was 347 million markka (mean 345 million) in a 292 to 390 million markka range.
Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
